text: Figure 6.33: LIN Configuration Entries (Fibex4Lin:LinConfigurationEntries) LIN only supports 64 identifiers. That creates the need for extending the address space. Hence the frames are identified by message ids from a much larger address space that is additionally separated by supplier ids. During runtime the master as- signs a LinId to the frame. In case of identical parts within a cluster the initial node ID (oldNad) is used to differentiate such nodes. emplate
